title: Возвращение Ильи и подпольный шеф  (Ilya's Return and the Underground Chef)

scenes.title: Возвращение старого официанта  (Return of the Former Waiter)
scenes.summary: Max reflects on how people from the past suddenly return just as former waiter Ilya walks into Claude Monet hoping Vika will hire him back.

scenes.title: Путёвка от Елены Павловны  (A Vacation Voucher from Elena Pavlovna)
scenes.summary: As Chef Barinov leaves the hospital under strict orders not to work, Elena Pavlovna surprises him with a last-minute vacation flight leaving in four hours.

scenes.title: Бывший парень Саши  (Sasha's Ex-Boyfriend)
scenes.summary: Max presses Sasha about Ilya and learns they broke up six months ago, while Ilya waits by the bar to ask Nagiyev for his waiter position back.

scenes.title: Проводы Шефа и рассказ Кости  (Seeing the Chef Off and Kostya's Story)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov thanks Elena Pavlovna for the trip voucher before leaving in a taxi, while Kostya tells Max that Ilya got him his job and nearly married Sasha.

scenes.title: Хитрость по дороге в аэропорт  (Trickery on the Way to the Airport)
scenes.summary: Vika rehires Ilya and sends him to put on a uniform, while Chef Barinov fakes an airport check-in call to Elena Pavlovna from inside the Claude Monet kitchen.

scenes.title: Возвращение Баринова на кухню  (Barinov Returns to the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Lyova announces that Chef Barinov will be away for two more weeks, only for Barinov himself to step out and catch Senya joking about him drinking beer.

scenes.title: Конспирация перед звонком Елены  (Conspiracy During Elena's Call)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov hushes the entire kitchen when Elena Pavlovna calls again, pretending he has bad reception on the plane before ordering the cooks back to work.

scenes.title: Встреча с Нагиевым и визит Елены  (Meeting Nagiyev and Elena's Visit)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev welcomes Chef Barinov back to work, and Barinov begs him not to tell Elena Pavlovna just as she walks into Claude Monet with two guests.

scenes.title: Просьба Елены Павловны  (Elena Pavlovna's Favor)
scenes.summary: Elena Pavlovna asks Nagiyev not to overwork Viktor Petrovich when he returns from his trip, while Chef Barinov hides underneath Nagiyev's desk.

scenes.title: Побег из-под стола  (Escaping from Under the Desk)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev plays along with Elena Pavlovna's story and scolds Barinov for skipping his trip, narrowly keeping him hidden when Elena returns for her forgotten phone.

scenes.title: Объяснение Ильи и ревность Макса  (Ilya's Explanation and Max's Jealousy)
scenes.summary: Ilya apologizes to Sasha for disappearing six months ago and says he is ready for a serious commitment, while Max spies on them from the kitchen window.

scenes.title: Стычка с Ильёй в зале  (Clash with Ilya in the Dining Room)
scenes.summary: Max confronts Ilya in the dining room to warn him away from Sasha until Vika breaks them up and orders Ilya to serve Elena Pavlovna's table quickly.

scenes.title: Гора соли для гостя Ильи  (A Mountain of Salt for Ilya's Guest)
scenes.summary: To get Ilya fired, Max dumps a mountain of salt onto his table's dish while Ilya's back is turned, causing the outraged guest to refuse the meal.

scenes.title: Скандал с солью и рассказ Елене  (The Salt Scandal and Telling Elena)
scenes.summary: Vika brings the salted plate back to Chef Barinov after the guest storms out, and that same guest complains to Elena Pavlovna at Arcobaleno about Claude Monet's kitchen.

scenes.title: Елена предлагает помощь Нагиеву  (Elena Offers Her Help to Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Feeling guilty that Claude Monet's kitchen is struggling while Barinov is on vacation, Elena Pavlovna returns to offer Nagiyev her services as temporary head chef.

scenes.title: Бесплатный шеф-повар  (A Free Head Chef)
scenes.summary: Once Elena Pavlovna says she will work completely for free, Nagiyev eagerly accepts and sends a waiter to warn Barinov in the kitchen.

scenes.title: Елена заступает на смену  (Elena Starts Her Shift)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev introduces Elena Pavlovna to the stunned kitchen crew as their temporary chef while Barinov hides, and Ilya taunts Max about Sasha in the hallway.

scenes.title: Намёки Ильи и поиски Саши  (Ilya's Hints and Looking for Sasha)
scenes.summary: Ilya's smug hints make Max worry that something happened with Sasha, and Max starts asking the staff if anyone has seen her.

scenes.title: Пожар для отвлечения внимания  (A Fire to Create a Distraction)
scenes.summary: When Sasha accidentally spots Chef Barinov hiding in the walk-in cooler, the cooks stage a kitchen fire to keep Elena Pavlovna from opening the cooler door.

scenes.title: Оборона холодильника и засада Макса  (Guarding the Cooler and Max's Ambush)
scenes.summary: The cooks bombard Elena Pavlovna with culinary questions to block her from the cooler while Barinov sneaks out, and Max thinks Sasha is hiding Ilya inside.

scenes.title: Холодный душ и признание Шефа  (A Cold Shower and the Chef's Confession)
scenes.summary: Max throws a bucket of ice water at the man leaving the cooler only to drench Ilya by mistake, while Chef Barinov confesses to Elena Pavlovna that he cannot live without his kitchen.
